name: London Tantei Monogatari
source:
Jane, who has opened a rooming house, is dumbfounded at the oddities of his first applicant; his name is William Holmes, professing himself to be a 'Consultation Detective'. Jane has never heard of such an occupation, and rather wants to avoid a strange lodger such as him. However, necessity is a hard master.

Watson, another lodging applicant, proposes to Jane just how Holmes may crack this case he's been working on…
translation: 开了一间出租屋的简，对第一位申请者的怪异行为感到目瞪口呆；他的名字叫威廉·福尔摩斯，自称是"咨询侦探"。简从未听说过这样的职业，更想避开他这样奇怪的房客。然而，生活所迫由不得人。另一位租房申请者华生向简提议，福尔摩斯也许能破解他一直在调查的案件……
